title: Back from the Tower
summary: Xiao Yan comes out of the Blazing Qi Refining Tower after two years, now a Dou Wang. To welcome him back, Lin Xiu Ya, now a Five-Star Dou Wang and an elder, spars with him in front of the academy and loses to one move. Medusa then turns up as a Dou Zong to kill him, but leaves him alive for now. Xiao Yan tells Su Qian he refined the Fallen Heart Flame, agrees to bring part of it back every year or two, and asks for herbs to restore Soul Power. Su Qian warns that Han Feng now leads the Black Alliance and that Fan Lao is about to attack Xiao Li, and Lin Yan, sent to guard Xiao Li, says he founded a secret group to kill Black Alliance members. Xiao Yan leads the Rock Gate into the Black-Corner Region, where Fan Lao's men are already wiping out Xiao Li's sentries, and races ahead alone.
